title: A Multi-Agent MLLM Framework for Imaging-Grounded Treatment Recommendation in Acute Ischemic Stroke
authors_text: Bicong Yan*, Zhuo Li*, Yanfeng Fan*, Ying Li, Li Chen, Xinyu Song, Yixiao Tang, Li Shen, Ruipeng Zhang#, Yuehua Li#. * Co-first authors. # Corresponding authors.
abstract: An imaging-grounded multi-agent multimodal large language model emulates a multidisciplinary stroke team through coordinated agents for triage, time-window assessment, multimodal imaging interpretation, contraindication screening, and treatment recommendation. In a retrospective evaluation of 1,658 suspected acute ischemic stroke cases from two centers, multi-agent coordination with retrieval-augmented generation improved treatment recommendation accuracy from 0.636 to 0.785 and Macro-F1 from 0.562 to 0.768.
